mode: offline regular-file snapshots only; no board collector included

exit_codes.3: observed active userspace lock or PMIC IRQ failure in supplied snapshot
exit_codes.4: readiness unproven; does not mean inspection failed

provenance_required_outside_inspector: Capture date and boot-image/kernel hashes; snapshots from one boot, no mixed candidates
Record permission failures and missing paths separately; absence of supplied file is UNKNOWN
InputReader-selected keylayout filename and sanitized key116 press/release events; not merely Generic.kl existence
Sanitized PMIC parent and RTC/key child interrupt counters before/after already-authorized normal key interaction; no new wake test authorized
Existing suspend entry/exit logs from the same kernel, if already captured. A successful new suspend test is NOT authorized by this inspector.

failure_branches.active_lock: BLOCKED for cooperative Android autosuspend; does not certify all direct state writes are prevented
failure_branches.missing_state: UNKNOWN; cannot infer CONFIG_SUSPEND=n without matching config
failure_branches.mem_s2idle: deep sleep NOT_ADVERTISED; mem is not evidence of deep sleep
failure_branches.rtc_interface: alarm access exists; parent IRQ delivery and resume UNKNOWN
failure_branches.pmic_fallback: parent request_irq failure can coexist with RTC/input nodes, because MFD retains irq_domain
failure_branches.watchdog_sysfs_missing: UNKNOWN; local CONFIG_WATCHDOG_SYSFS=n explains missing attributes
failure_branches.watchdog_active: hazard to assess; source suspend callback exists but bound running driver and success unknown

prohibitions: No writes to power/state, mem_sleep, wake_lock/unlock, RTC alarm, watchdog or PMIC
No live services/process changes, charging-policy changes, flashing, or guessed GPIO/registers
No readiness PASS from passive snapshots alone
config_input: kernel.config must contain only selected CONFIG_PM_*, SUSPEND, RTC, WATCHDOG, MEDIATEK_WATCHDOG and KEYBOARD_MTK_PMIC lines, retain not-set lines and source hash; complete local config196240 bytes intentionally rejected by64KiB bound.
